blurb: Guests can enjoy public karting on an 8-meter wide outdoor track with easy-to-operate concession karts suitable for kids and adults. The facility offers practice sessions, league racing, championship series, and personalized racing school and camps for drivers aged 7 and up. Special events, parties, and corporate team building are also available with tailored packages.
